concerns: No blocking implementation defect found in the reviewed source.
For a 14-tick source-to-loss path, only source positions0..17 of a32-event window retain the full within-window derivative; cross-boundary values persist but historical source derivatives detach.
Numerical reachability and risk advantage do not certify motor semantic utility, NLL improvement, global regression cause, convergence or isolated timing benefit.
Block intervals are conditional descriptive evidence for one evolving trajectory under a block-dependence assumption, not seed-population uncertainty.
The inactive Gemini optional predictor has a separate eager/Graph auxiliary-objective concern; the reviewed pipeline explicitly excludes it.
